cmsFields.title: NATS Server review: retention and delivery controls
cmsFields.subtitle: Which JetStream controls shape retention and delivery, and what must applications still guarantee?
cmsFields.summary: NATS Server repository review of JetStream retention, acknowledgments and resource controls, separating source mechanisms from delivery guarantees.
keyTakeaways: JetStream configuration separates server resource budgets from individual stream policies.
Stream retention, storage and replica settings are explicit adoption decisions.
Consumer acknowledgments do not by themselves establish exactly-once external side effects.
